general.groupStartupDesc: Behavior that runs when Claudepot starts up, plus the diagnostic overlays you can opt into.
general.groupCcDesc: Claude Code behavior. Written to ~/.claude/settings.json and shared by every account that uses Claude Code's config.

showBoards.label: Show Boards
showBoards.hint: Durable surfaces agents write into. On trial and off by default — toggle any time with ⌃⌥⌘B.

launchAtLogin.label: Launch at login
launchAtLogin.hint: Claudepot starts automatically when you log in.

showWindow.label: Show window on startup
showWindow.hint: Off: Claudepot launches into the tray with no window. Click the tray icon to open it.

hideDock.label: Hide dock icon
hideDock.hint: Tray-only mode: no dock icon, no Cmd+Tab, no app menu bar. The window still opens from the tray.

appearance.groupDesc: Theme controls flow through CSS variables on the html element; no component code is aware of the active mode.

active.label: Active
active.hint: Which palette the app is rendering right now.

locks.desc: Force-break a stale lock file left behind by a crashed rename. Generates an audit trail.
locks.breakTitle: Force-break the lock file and create an audit trail

diagnostics.groupDesc: Read-only view of platform, active slots, and the identity Claude Code is currently authenticated as.

about.author: Author
about.signingNote: HANDO K.K. is the Apple Developer–registered entity that code-signs and notarizes Claudepot. macOS shows this name in System Settings → General → Login Items & Extensions → App Background Activity when “Launch at login” is enabled, and in occasional “ran in the background” notifications. It’s the legal name behind the Developer ID certificate — not a third-party process.

updates.unsupportedDesc: In-app updates aren't available on this install — your package manager owns this binary. Check the Releases page for new versions.
updates.groupDesc: Claudepot checks an authenticated, minisign-signed manifest hosted on GitHub Releases. Your install only updates to versions signed by the project's release key.

auto.label: Check automatically
auto.hint: Background checks run after the chosen interval has elapsed since the last successful check.

frequency.label: Frequency
frequency.manual: Only when I click Check now

channel.label: Release channel
channel.betaHint: Beta: you'll be offered prereleases (vX.Y.Z-beta.N) as well as stable releases. Earlier access, less tested. Switch back to Stable any time — it applies on the next check.
channel.stableHint: Stable: you're only offered fully-released versions. Choose Beta to also receive prereleases and try new features early.

allReleases.label: All releases
allReleases.hint: Browse the changelog and download installers for any platform.

status.strandedVersioned: You're on a prerelease newer than the current stable (v{{version}}) — you'll be offered the next stable release
status.stranded: You're on a prerelease newer than the current stable — you'll be offered the next stable release

logs.title: Diagnostic logs
logs.desc: Every tracing event and any panic the app emits is written to a rolling daily log file. Open the folder to attach the most recent file when reporting an unexpected quit. Files older than 7 days are pruned at startup.

notifications.groupActivityDesc: The live Activity feature watches the transcript files Claude Code already writes, so you can see which of your sessions are busy, waiting, or idle at a glance. Nothing is sent anywhere; all data stays on this Mac.
notifications.groupAlertsDesc: OS notifications when a live session or long-running operation crosses one of these thresholds. 'Waiting for you' and the 90% usage threshold default on; the rest are opt-in. OS notifications only fire when the Claudepot window is unfocused — the bell icon in the top bar shows the in-app history either way.

enable.label: Enable Activity
enable.hint: Start the live runtime. Turning this off stops all polling and clears the LIVE strip.

hideThinking.label: Hide thinking by default
hideThinking.hint: Thinking blocks render as 'redacted · N chars' until you click to reveal. Privacy-forward.

errorBurst.label: Alert on error burst
errorBurst.hint: At least two tool results with is_error=true inside a 60-second window.

waiting.label: Alert when waiting for you
waiting.hint: A session paused for permission, plan-mode approval, or a clarifying answer.

taskDone.label: Alert when task finished
taskDone.hint: A session busy for 2+ minutes returned to idle. The 2-minute gate filters out drive-by edits.

stuck.label: Alert when stuck
stuck.hint: Empty = off. Fires 10 minutes after the last tool result; this value is shown in the toast copy only.

usage.label: Alert at usage thresholds
usage.hint: Fires once per (5h / 7d window × threshold) per reset cycle for the CLI-active account. Polled every 5 min. When utilization jumps past two thresholds in one poll, only the higher one fires. Click any chip to toggle; empty = feature off.

subWindows.label: Include 7-day Opus / Sonnet sub-windows
subWindows.hint: The umbrella 7-day window is always checked. Per-model sub-quotas usually track it for users near cap, so leaving them off avoids triple-firing for what reads as one cap. Turn on if you watch each model's quota separately.

opDone.label: Alert when long operations complete
opDone.hint: Verify-all, project rename, session prune/slim/share/move, account login, or clean projects — fires an OS notification when any of these terminate while the window is unfocused.

test.label: Send test notification
test.hint: Fire a sample OS notification to verify permissions and that the runtime path is wired. Doesn't toggle any preference.
test.title: Claudepot test
test.body: If you see this, notifications are working.
test.denied: OS notification permission denied. Open System Settings to re-enable.
test.notGranted: Notification permission was not granted. Click Request to retry.
test.unreachable: Couldn't reach the OS notification system. Try again, or check that Claudepot has Notification permission in System Settings.

categories.desc: More notification categories. Categories already covered by the toggles above (Error, Stuck, Waiting, Op done, Usage, Service status) are hidden by default — flip the bottom toggle to reveal them.
categories.showAllHint: Include those already covered by the toggles above.

permission.label: OS notification permission
permission.grantedHint: Granted. Claudepot can post system-level alerts when the window is unfocused.
permission.deniedHint: Denied. Re-enable Claudepot in System Settings → Notifications to receive alerts.
permission.notRequestedHint: Not yet requested. Click Request to enable system-level alerts.
permission.deniedToast: Notification permission denied. Open System Settings to re-enable.

github.desc: Personal Access Token for publishing session exports as gists. Stored in the Keychain; only the last four characters are ever shown.
github.envNote: GITHUB_TOKEN env var is set — it overrides the stored token for uploads. Unset the env var if you want Save/Clear to take effect.

network.intro: Surface upstream incidents from status.claude.com and measure round-trip latency to the hosts Claude Code actually hits. See xiaolai/anthropic-claude-surge-rules-set for the curated registry the host list is seeded from.

poll.label: Check status.claude.com
poll.detail: One small request every {{minutes}} minutes. Indicates when Anthropic itself is degraded.

osNotify.label: Show OS notification on status change
osNotify.detail: Off by default — false positives from Anthropic blips can train you to ignore real signals. The bell-icon log gets every transition regardless.

latency.title: Path latency
latency.label: Probe latency when window opens
latency.detail: HEAD request to each Claude host. On-demand only — no continuous background polling, by design.

rotation.intro: Auto-switch the active CLI account when an Anthropic usage window crosses a threshold you set. Triggers fire from Anthropic's /api/oauth/usage data, polled every 5 minutes. The default Confirm mode shows a toast and waits for your click; switch to Auto once you trust the rule.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete rotation rule?
deleteConfirm.body: Rule {{id}} will be removed. You can re-add it later.

rotation.emptyWithAccounts: No rotation rules yet. Add one to auto-switch accounts when usage thresholds trip.
rotation.emptyNoAccounts: Add at least one Anthropic account before creating rotation rules — the candidate picker reads the account list.

ruleId.label: Rule id
ruleId.hint: Short, unique identifier — appears in the audit log.

fireWhen.label: Fire when
fireWhen.hint: Anthropic's per-account utilization for the active CLI account.

selector.leastUsedHint: Pick the candidate with the lowest utilization on the chosen window.
selector.roundRobinHint: Pick the next candidate after the active one in list order.
selector.explicitHint: Always swap to one specific account.

mode.label: Mode
mode.hint: Confirm shows a toast before swapping. Auto swaps immediately.

minInterval.label: Min interval between swaps (seconds)
minInterval.hint: Across all rules. Stops cascade swaps from a single tick.

maxSwaps.label: Max swaps per cycle
maxSwaps.hint: Per-rule cap inside the trigger window's reset cycle.

rotationModal.dryHint: Evaluates this rule against the current usage snapshot — answers "would this fire right now?"

retention.loadErrorLead: Couldn’t read Claude Code’s retention setting, so this pane cannot tell you what is scheduled for deletion.
retention.modeDefault: {{days}} days — Claude Code's default, not a choice you made
retention.modeDisabled: Transcripts are not being saved at all
retention.modeInvalid: Invalid value ({{days}}) — Claude Code's settings schema rejects it

risk.deletable_one: {{num}} transcript will be deleted the next time Claude Code starts.
risk.deletable_other: {{num}} transcripts will be deleted the next time Claude Code starts.
risk.horizon_one: {{num}} more crosses the cutoff within {{days}} days.
risk.horizon_other: {{num}} more cross the cutoff within {{days}} days.
risk.scanIncomplete: Part of Claude Code’s transcript folder couldn’t be read, so these counts are a floor, not a total.
risk.silent: Claude Code does this silently — it never reports what it deleted.
risk.suppressed: Claude Code is skipping cleanup entirely because this value makes its settings file invalid. That is protecting your transcripts by accident — correct the value rather than restoring the default, which would re-arm deletion.

retention.nestedNote: Cleanup only removes the {{total}} top-level session transcripts. {{nested}} nested files (subagent runs, tool results) are never removed, so the folder keeps growing while conversations are deleted — disk usage cannot reveal this loss.
retention.keepToast: Claude Code will keep transcripts for {{label}}.
retention.bufferNote: A longer window buys time; it is not a backup. These files still live in Claude Code's cache directory under Claude Code's rules, and they grow by roughly a gigabyte a week on heavy use.
retention.dangerNote: Both re-enable deletion. Neither can be undone for transcripts already removed.

confirmRestore.title: Restore Claude Code's default retention?
confirmRestore.bodyCount: Retention returns to 30 days. Claude Code will delete every transcript older than that the next time it starts — {{num}} transcripts are currently kept. This cannot be undone.
confirmRestore.body: Retention returns to 30 days. Claude Code will delete every transcript older than that the next time it starts. This cannot be undone.

retention.restoredToast: Retention restored to Claude Code's 30-day default.

confirmDisable.title: Stop saving transcripts entirely?
confirmDisable.intro: This writes cleanupPeriodDays: 0, which does two things:
confirmDisable.li1: Claude Code stops writing transcripts for new sessions.
confirmDisable.li2: Every existing transcript is deleted the next time Claude Code starts.
confirmDisable.li2Count: Every existing transcript ({{num}} on this machine) is deleted the next time Claude Code starts.
confirmDisable.outro: Session resume, search, and every Claudepot surface built on transcripts stop working. This cannot be undone.

health.desc: Read-only summary of claude doctor. Captured by spawning Claude Code in a pty and parsing its output; cached for 60 s. Distinct from Settings → Diagnostics, which shows Claudepot’s own self-check.
health.failedNote: The pill in the chrome falls back to the last-known-good snapshot.
health.rawRecorded: Raw output is recorded for review.
health.noSections: No sections parsed from the doctor output.
health.running: Running claude doctor… (first call per minute takes 6–10 s)

mcp.healthDesc: Spawns claudepot mcp memory-server, runs initialize + tools/list, counts the tools.
mcp.introDesc: Configuring an MCP entry alone isn't enough — agents have to be told when to call the tools. This snippet does that. Pick a scope, install it once, then paste the @include line into the target file Claudepot names. Future regenerations refresh the file in place; the @include line never changes.
mcp.scopeUserDesc: — writes ~/.claude/claudepot-mcp-instructions.md; paste @include into ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, ~/.codex/AGENTS.md, ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md. Loads in every project.
mcp.scopeProjectDesc: — writes {{path}}; paste @include into the project's AGENTS.md (the canonical source per /init-workspace). Loads only in that project.

protected.errUncRoot: Path cannot be a UNC root.
protected.errBareDrive: Path cannot be a bare drive letter; specify a directory under the drive.
protected.errNotAbsolute: Path must be absolute (start with '/', '~', a drive letter, or '\\').
protected.errFsRoot: Path cannot be a filesystem root.
protected.errDriveRoot: Path cannot be a drive root; specify a directory under the drive.
protected.desc: Cleaning will not strip ~/.claude.json entries or history.jsonl lines for these paths. The CC artifact directory under ~/.claude/projects/ is still removable — only sibling state is preserved.
protected.addTitle: Add this path to the protected list
protected.addHint: Enter an absolute path (or one starting with ~) to enable Add.
protected.resetTitle: Discard your additions and removals — restore the built-in defaults

artifacts.autoPurged_one: Auto-purged {{count}} trash entry older than {{days}} days
artifacts.autoPurged_other: Auto-purged {{count}} trash entries older than {{days}} days
artifacts.noneDisabled: Nothing disabled. Use the Disable action in the Config tree to hide an artifact from Claude Code without deleting it.

confirmTrash.title: Move {{kind}} to trash?
confirmTrash.body: "{{name}}" will move to trash. You can restore it within ~30 days.

trash.title: Artifact trash
trash.empty: Trash is empty. Trashed artifacts are restorable here for ~{{days}} days.
trash.forgetTitle: Forget — remove from disk, no further undo

confirmForget.title: Forget this trash entry?
confirmForget.body: This entry will be removed from disk. There's no further undo.

trash.purgeTitle: Purge Healthy entries older than {{days}} days

confirmPurge.title: Purge old trash entries?
confirmPurge.body: Healthy entries older than {{days}} days will be removed. Corrupt entries are kept until manually forgotten.

trash.tamperedTitle: Payload differs from the byte count / sha256 the manifest recorded — restore refused; investigate or forget.

recover.title: Recover trash entry
recover.intro: This entry doesn't have a complete manifest. Confirm where it should be restored and what kind of artifact it is. The entry's payload contents are kept intact — only the destination is synthesized.
recover.pathError: Path must be absolute (starts with / or C:\).

attribution.resetToast: Attribution reset to Claude Code's default.
attribution.offToast: Attribution off — commits and PRs carry none.
attribution.label: Commit & PR attribution
attribution.hint: Whether Claude's attribution appears on git commits and pull requests, and what it says. Off removes the “Co-Authored-By” trailer and the “Generated with Claude Code” line everywhere.
attribution.bothEmpty: Both fields empty — use Off instead.

models.cleared: Model allowlist cleared — every model is selectable again.
models.label: Selectable models
models.hintRestricts: Only these models can be chosen in /model, --model, and fallback chains. Order matters: with enforcement on, Default becomes the first entry.
models.hintEmpty: Empty — every model your account can reach is selectable. Add a family alias, a version prefix, or a full model id.
models.enforceLabel: Apply the list to the Default model
models.enforceInert: Set, but inert: Claude Code ignores it while the list is empty, so Default stays unrestricted. Add at least one model above. Needs Claude Code {{version}} or later.
models.enforceHint: Without this, picking "Default" in /model bypasses the list entirely and resolves to your account's default model. With it, Default becomes the first allowed entry. Needs Claude Code {{version}} or later.

companion.keptLocal: Companion output kept local — cloud Artifacts off.
companion.label: Keep companion output local
companion.lockedHint: Overridden by the CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ARTIFACT environment variable. Unset it to control this here.
companion.hint: Off by default: Claude Code publishes charts and mini-apps as private pages in the signed-in account's claude.ai gallery. Turn on to keep that output as a local file — it then belongs to no account and survives account switches.

thinking.onToast: Extended thinking on by default for new sessions.
thinking.offToast: Extended thinking off by default — new sessions skip it.
thinking.label: Extended thinking by default
thinking.lockedHint: Overridden by the MAX_THINKING_TOKENS environment variable. Unset it to control this here.
thinking.hint: On by default: Claude thinks before responding on supported models — better quality, more latency and tokens. Turn off to make new sessions skip thinking by default. Only affects new sessions; per-session flags still win.

fastMode.onToast: Fast mode on — new Opus sessions run faster and bill to usage credits.
fastMode.offToast: Fast mode off — new sessions run at standard Opus speed and rates.
fastMode.perSessionOnToast: Fast mode now resets each session — re-enable it with /fast.
fastMode.perSessionOffToast: Fast mode preference now persists across sessions.
fastMode.label: Fast mode
fastMode.lockedHint: Overridden by the CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FAST_MODE environment variable. Unset it to control this here.
fastMode.hint: Runs {{models}} up to 2.5× faster at {{rate}} instead of the standard rate — same model, same quality. Charged to usage credits, not your plan's included usage, from the first token. Needs usage credits enabled on the account; Team and Enterprise also need an owner to turn it on.
fastMode.perSessionOnHint: Every new session starts with fast mode off; re-enable it with /fast. Your saved preference is kept.
fastMode.perSessionOffHint: Fast mode persists across sessions once turned on. Enable this to make each session start with it off instead.
